description: This file defines the EntityContentComplete class, a deprecated Drupal migration destination plugin for migrating entire entity revision tables. It includes methods for retrieving entity IDs, creating or loading entities, updating entities, saving, and rollback functionality.

classes.name: EntityContentComplete
classes.description: A deprecated Drupal migration destination plugin class for migrating complete entity revision tables, providing methods for entity retrieval, creation, updating, saving, and rollback.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs for the entity, revision, and language code for migration.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Loads or creates an entity based on migration row data and old destination IDs.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates the entity with data from the migration row and sets rollback action.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the entity and returns its ID and revision ID.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Deletes the entity and its translations during rollback.
